name: Grand Melee
review:
A comic royal battle on six reels with 1,193 connecting ways. Sticky respins unlock grid expansion, symbol expansion and symbol upgrades.

Those respins are where it comes alive: each one can grow the grid, enlarge symbols or upgrade them, so a small start can snowball. The goofy medieval art matches the chaos. High volatility, 5,000x cap, 96.17% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
